pick.headline: Russia frees prices: shock therapy begins
pick.summary: On 2 January 1992 the Russian government lifted state controls on most consumer prices, the opening move of Yegor Gaidar's economic reform.
pick.significance: Prices multiplied within weeks, wiping out savings and making the reform programme politically explosive. It set the terms of Russia's turbulent transition to a market economy.
